description: Ornith Supervisor Code & Hardware Contracts Registry

contracts.description: Zero tolerance for silent fallbacks (.get(key, default), .setdefault(key, default), .pop(key, default), getattr(obj, attr, default), or ternary d[k] if k in d else default). Code must fail fast with direct key indexing or raise KeyError.

Forbidden dummy fallback literals on telemetry, joystick coordinates, or motor state in JavaScript and HTML (<script> blocks). Nullish coalescing (?? <literal>), logical OR (|| <literal>), ternary defaults, or destructuring defaults on state are banned.
Hardcoded 2048 or 0x800 neutral ticks are prohibited. Servos 1-6 bounds and homing offsets must load dynamically from follower.json; Servos 7-8 from calibration_aux.json.
Swallowed exceptions (except: pass, except: ...) are prohibited. Must raise descriptive exceptions or log explicit tracebacks.
Forbidden hardcoded motion scaling factors (* 0.5, * 0.8) or artificial sub-range cages on joint kinematics. Rom and modifier intensities must load from JSON configuration.
Modified hardware or UI code must be synced to physical target devices (Pi 4B @ 192.168.0.86) and MD5-verified before approval.
Modular apps must consume their _CONFIG values directly in AppMetadata and operational paths instead of hardcoded strings or divergent names.
Choreography sanitization and save routines must preserve mandatory schema keys (specifically 'probabilities' and 'tracks').
JavaScript functions must not reference undeclared identifiers or rely on out-of-scope variables that cause ReferenceErrors at runtime.
Network and audio playback dispatches must occur only after player or motion engine initialization has succeeded.
Configured storage paths and library subdirectories must resolve to valid, un-bifurcated directories on target host devices.
